chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Switzerland.
Switzerland is a small, peaceful, and beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Switzerland?
Switzerland is in Central Europe.
It is next to France, Germany, Italy, Austria, and Liechtenstein.
It has many mountains, lakes, and villages.
Switzerland is a landlocked country, so it has no sea.
What is the capital city of Switzerland?
The capital city is Bern.
Bern is quiet and historic, with old buildings and a river.

Other famous cities include Zurich, the largest city with banks and shops, Geneva near France with the United Nations, Lucerne, a tourist city with a lake and mountains, Basel near Germany and France.
How many people live in Switzerland?
About 9 million people live in Switzerland.
Many people live in cities, but there are also villages in the mountains.
Switzerland is known for being safe, clean, and organized.
What language do people speak in Switzerland?
Switzerland has four official languages.
German, spoken in the north and center, French in the west, Italian in the south, Romanche a small language spoken in some villages.
Many people also speak English, especially in cities and tourist places.
What is the weather like in Switzerland?
Switzerland has four seasons.
Spring, cool and fresh with flowers.
Summer, warm and sunny.
Autumn, colorful with falling leaves.
Winter, cold and snowy, especially in the mountains.
In winter, people go skiing.
In summer, they go hiking and swimming in lakes.
What does Switzerland look like?
Switzerland has the Alps, high snowy mountains, green valleys and meadows, lakes like Lake Geneva and Lake Lucerne, small villages with wooden houses, modern cities and historic towns.
Nature is very clean and well protected.
What animals live in Switzerland?
You can see cows with bells in the fields, sheep, goats and horses, deer, foxes and wild boars.
In the Alps, ibex, marmots and eagles, cows and cheese are symbols of Switzerland.
What do people eat in Switzerland?
Swiss food is simple and tasty.
People eat bread, cheese and potatoes.
Meat, vegetables and chocolate.

Famous dishes include fondue, melted cheese with bread, raclette, melted cheese with potatoes, rusty, grated and fried potatoes, bircher musley, oats with fruit and yogurt, Swiss chocolate, sweet and delicious.
What do people drink in Switzerland?
People drink water.
It is very clean from the mountains.
Milk and coffee, tea, fruit juice.
Adults may drink wine or beer.
Switzerland has many natural springs and fresh tap water.
What is life like in Switzerland?
Life in Switzerland is calm, safe and well organized.
People go to school, work and enjoy free time.
People like hiking, cycling and skiing, reading and visiting museums, spending time with family and friends, enjoying nature and quiet places.
Trains and buses are on time and very clean.
What are some holidays and traditions in Switzerland?

National Day August 1st with fireworks and flags, Christmas with lights, markets and warm drinks, Easter with chocolate eggs and family meals, Carnival with costumes and music in some cities, Alp descent festivals in autumn when cows come down from the mountains.
Every region has its own customs, music and clothes.
Some fun facts about Switzerland.
Switzerland is neutral.
It does not take sides in wars.
Swiss watches are famous around the world.
The Swiss flag is red with a white cross.
The red cross started in Switzerland.
There are more than 1,500 lakes in the country.
Now you know many things about Switzerland.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the cities, nature, food and tradition.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
See you next time.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in German, all feeders in.
In French, au revoir.
And in Italian, arrivederci.
